title: OpenAPI Cursor & Offset Pagination Schema Example
description: How to declare query parameters and response pagination wrapper metadata in OpenAPI specifications.
problemStatement: Collection endpoints without pagination parameters risk server timeout crashes when returning large datasets.

badExample.explanation: Collection endpoint returning array without limit/offset or cursor parameters.
badExample.code:
paths:
  /v1/orders:
    get:
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of orders

goodExample.explanation: Cursor-based pagination with limit and starting_after parameters.
goodExample.code:
paths:
  /v1/orders:
    get:
      summary: List orders with cursor pagination
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 20
        - name: starting_after
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated orders payload
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
                  has_more:
                    type: boolean
